I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Child Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services and therefore minimum Services for victims of Violence are required. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to implement Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Child Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.
